name: PR detail Overview renders the seeded PR brief as stale, and a review-focus row opens that file in the diff
description: From PR #482, confirm the PR Brief card (L05) is the first block of the Overview tab and renders the newer of the two seeded pr_brief rows — its `what` and `why` literals, and its STALENESS banner, which is the honest state because a `seed:`-prefixed state_key can never equal a SHA-256 hex (AC-39). Loading the page generates nothing: the only model call this feature makes is behind the Regenerate button, which no step here touches (AC-07). Then click the first review-focus row BY ITS OWN accessible name — three rows would otherwise share one locator — and land on the Files tab with ?tab=diff&file=&line= set in one navigation, the file expanded (AC-33); reload and confirm the same URL and the same file come back, which is the whole point of the focus living in the URL rather than in SmartDiffViewer's state (AC-34). Exercises usePrBrief → PrBriefCard → ReviewFocusList → page.openFile → DiffTab → SmartDiffViewer → FileCard over GET /pulls/:id/brief, which makes zero model calls. Read-only seeded data; every asserted string is a seed literal (server/src/db/seed.ts, DEMO_BRIEF_WHAT / DEMO_BRIEF_WHY and the seed:v2 row) or a message-file literal (client/messages/en/brief.json). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
